title: 0.9.2 Release Provenance Policy (frozen)
note: Provenance policy defines identity, predicate, and digest-binding rules for every official artifact family. Candidate-bound provenance records are produced solely by Task 10.7 against the W5-frozen candidate SHA.

provenance_model.subject_binding: Every provenance record binds artifact sha256, candidate_sha (W5 freeze SHA), feature-manifest digest, ABI version, producer workflow run id, and artifact identity
provenance_model.evidence_commit_sha: Separate metadata when evidence is stored outside the candidate branch; the candidate_sha is never redefined
provenance_model.retention: Immutable; retrieval uses immutable run/artifact IDs per the Artifact Registry Contract

source_archive.provenance_form: release-manifest.json entry with source URL, source SHA (git commit), and per-file sha256
source_archive.predicate: Source archive provenance predicate: repo URL + git commit SHA + archive sha256
source_archive.consumer: verify-release-manifest.py, release gates, W6 evidence consumers

deb.provenance_form: candidate-release-artifact-index.json entry + package ABI manifest (package-abi-manifest.json) + SBOM entry
deb.predicate: DEB provenance: candidate_sha + artifact sha256 + feature-manifest digest + ABI version + build runner identity + nginx version

rpm.provenance_form: candidate-release-artifact-index.json entry + package ABI manifest + SBOM entry
rpm.predicate: RPM provenance: candidate_sha + artifact sha256 + feature-manifest digest + ABI version + build runner identity + nginx version

oci.provenance_form: Cosign attestation (in-toto predicate) attached to the image + provenance-index.json entry
oci.predicate: in-toto/slsa-provenance predicate covering image manifest digest, source commit, builder identity

homebrew_formula_source.provenance_form: Formula sha256 stanza + tag archive verification record
homebrew_formula_source.predicate: Formula provenance: tag archive sha256 equals local git archive of the resolved tag commit

homebrew_bottle.provenance_form: Bottle sha256 in bottle JSON (when applicable)
homebrew_bottle.predicate: Bottle provenance: bottle sha256 binds exact bottle bytes

sbom.binding: SBOM digest bound to the artifact digest in sbom-index.json; SBOM covers the built artifact's dependency tree

security_scan.scan_types: SAST (CodeQL + supplemental gates) and dependency audit (cargo-deny)
security_scan.report: artifacts/release/0.9.2/security-scan-report.json produced by Task 10.7; clear or formally accepted residual risk

candidate_binding_rules: Task 10.7 is the sole producer of authoritative candidate-bound provenance after the Task 10.6 SHA freeze
Failed or superseded attempts retain unique immutable run_id and attempt values and are never referenced by the W5 checkpoint or W6 inputs

Every record binds candidate_sha, artifact digest, feature-manifest digest, ABI version, producer, consumer, retention, storage class, run id, attempt, authoritative flag, superseded attempt, and retrieval location
Runtime evidence storage SHALL NOT create a new production candidate commit
